question.prompt: In rectangle \(ABCD\), \(AB=6\) and \(BC=8\). Draw the reflection of rectangle \(ABCD\) across line \(AB\). The reflection of point \(C\) is \(C'\). Find the distance between \(C\) and \(C'\).

solutions.explanation: The distance from \(C\) to line \(AB\) equals \(BC=8\), and \(CC'\perp AB\), so \(CC'=2\times8=16\).
solutions.title: Use the perpendicular distance
